import re

TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<title>[A-Za-z][^\s].*?)\s*$")
RULE = re.compile(r"^-{3,}\s*$")
SETTING = re.compile(r"^(?P<setting>[a-z][a-z0-9]*)\s+(?P<value>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s*$")
CONT = re.compile(r"^\s{2,}(?P<value>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    entries, cols, used, skip = [], ["entry"], [], []
    cur, last = None, None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if RULE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        # a title line is the one right before a rule: it opens a new entry
        if j + 1 < len(lines) and RULE.match(lines[j + 1]) and TITLE.match(ln):
            cur = {"entry": ln.strip()}
            last = None
            entries.append(cur)
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = SETTING.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None:
            last = m.group("setting")
            cur[last] = m.group("value")
            if last not in cols:
                cols.append(last)
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = CONT.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None and last is not None:
            # a multi-valued setting (displayorder) continues on indented lines
            cur[last] += "," + m.group("value")
            used.append(j)
    entries = [{k: e.get(k, "") for k in cols} for e in entries]
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "entries", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": entries}],
            "skip": skip}
